fichas.title: Cinema auditorium seating and layout
fichas.summary: Guidance for auditorium floor gradients, stepped seating, aisle widths, row spacing, seat counts, and seating layouts. Cinema seats are normally larger than minimum dimensions stipulated by the Public Assembly Regulations.

fichas.title: Cinema auditorium acoustics and sound reproduction
fichas.summary: Acoustic guidance covers separation of adjacent auditoriums, ceiling sound-directing surfaces, echo prevention, reverberation, and loudspeaker distribution. Sound reproduction descriptions include optical stereo and magnetic multichannel systems.
uses: Distribute sound evenly across seating rows

dimensions.label: Sound insulation of walls between auditoriums
dimensions.context: Approximate stated wall separation rating; adjacent auditoriums should be separated by walls.

dimensions.label: Frequency range
dimensions.context: Frequency notation printed alongside the approximate wall rating.

dimensions.label: Maximum front-to-back volume difference
dimensions.context: Loudspeaker distribution should keep the volume difference between front and back rows within this limit.

fichas.title: Programme, panoramic, and Circarama cinemas
fichas.summary: Programme cinemas are described as specialist-film venues, often combined with eating and drinking facilities. Panoramic and Circarama cinemas use expansive screen formats and specialized projection arrangements; Circarama venues are associated with adventure parks and planetariums.
uses: Provide eating and drinking facilities alongside cinema use
Present panoramic or immersive film experiences
